content_sections.heading: About President's Secretariat
content_sections.text: The President's Secretariat is at Rashtrapati Bhavan, New Delhi, and its Administration Section issued this notice. The Under Secretary (Admin) invites the applications on behalf of the President of India. The post serves Rashtrapati Niketan, Dehradun, with its work centred on Rashtrapati Udyan.

content_sections.heading: President's Secretariat Park Superintendent Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The line above the notice's pay table refers to "05 posts", but its pay table and opening paragraph both give 01 post. The Secretariat may also alter the number of positions at any stage without notice. The remuneration is fixed and paid monthly by direct bank transfer. Pay for part of a month is pro rata, taking 30 days in a month. No other allowances are admissible. Pay is due only for the period of actual service under the Contract Agreement. Additional work outside the Terms of Reference, done with the Secretariat's prior authorization, carries no additional fee. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Day-to-day operational management and coordination of Rashtrapati Udyan. Planning and monitoring visitor management and visitor facilities. Coordinating with the office of Rashtrapati Niketan and reporting to the Manager, Niketan. Supervising and coordinating manpower deployed at the Udyan and monitoring their duties. Coordinating and monitoring outsourced agencies and service providers. Monitoring cleanliness, upkeep, facilities and overall service standards. Preparing operational plans and schedules, and submitting reports from time to time. Coordinating special events, programmes, visits and other activities in the Udyan. Identifying operational gaps and suggesting ways to improve efficiency, visitor experience and resource utilisation. Any other work assigned by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: President's Secretariat Park Superintendent Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates upto the age of 45 years as on 30 September 2026 are eligible. The notice separately says all eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date of the application. Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university. At least 3 years of post-qualification professional experience in operations, management, administration, visitor management, hospitality, tourism, event management or any related field. MBA from a recognized university. Working knowledge of computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office, data management and internet applications. The official notification (PDF) gives the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Selection Committee set up by the President's Secretariat carries out the entire selection process. Shortlisted applicants are informed by mail, e-mail or telephonic message for interview/written test. Eligible candidates have to appear for a Personal Interview before the Selection Committee. A selected applicant cannot withdraw candidature and must join within the time set by the Secretariat. From the opening of applications until selection is finalized, applicants should not contact the Secretariat about their application. Any effort to influence the process may result in rejection.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The notice is inconsistent on medical cover: its pay section says no medical facility shall be extended, while its Health Cover section says the Park Superintendent is eligible for medical facilities from President's Estate Clinic. Other printed conditions: A declaration about marital status is required. The engagement will be terminated if the candidate has more than one spouse living, unless exempted under the rules or laws. An oath of allegiance or a solemn affirmation to the Constitution of India is required. Absolute integrity and confidentiality must be maintained, and any actual or potential conflict of interest must be disclosed. Corrupt, fraudulent, collusive or coercive practices can lead to disqualification, either indefinitely or for a stated period. The Park Superintendent is liable to pay taxes under the applicable laws of India, and to pay damages decided by the Secretariat for losses caused by negligence. Before resignation is accepted, all office property must be handed over to the Manager and a 'No Demand Certificate' obtained from Rashtrapati Niketan, Dehradun. Disputes go to the Secretary to the President, who may appoint an arbitrator. Court jurisdiction is within Delhi, and the language of arbitration is English.

faq.question: Q1. Is an MBA compulsory for the Park Superintendent post?
faq.answer: No. An MBA is a desired qualification; the essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university.

faq.question: Q2. What kind of experience counts?
faq.answer: The notice accepts at least 3 years of post-qualification professional experience in operations, management, administration, visitor management, hospitality, tourism, event management or any related field.

faq.question: Q3. Can the contract run beyond one year?
faq.answer: Yes, it may be extended for one further year based on performance and progress of activities.

faq.question: Q4. Is accommodation provided?
faq.answer: No residential accommodation is provided from the President's Estate Pool of Accommodation.

faq.question: Q5. Do I get allowances on top of ₹45,000?
faq.answer: No. The notice allows no other allowances, and TA/DA, transport and telephone facilities are also excluded.

faq.question: Q6. Can I keep another job or assignment during the contract?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is full-time, and no other assignment is allowed during this period.

faq.question: Q7. I am currently employed. What do I need for the interview?
faq.answer: You need a "No objection Certificate" from your employer. Without it, you will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: Shortlisted applicants are informed by mail, e-mail or telephonic message. Personal enquiries about applications are not entertained.

faq.question: Q9. Will I be reporting to the Manager?
faq.answer: Yes. The Park Superintendent reports to the Manager, Niketan, and coordinates with the office of Rashtrapati Niketan.
